title: Test-Time Gradient Guidance of Flow Policies in Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2606.11087v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Expressive continuous control policies, such as diffusion and flow models, form the backbone of recent advances in scaling imitation learning for simulated and real robot control. While they are known to scale stably in the supervised imitation learning setting, incorporating them into reinforcement learning (RL) pipelines for policy improvement has proven more difficult. It often requires specialized training objectives or backpropagating through denoising processes, which cause well-known issues with stability and affect scalability. In this paper we study the question of whether simple policy improvement schemes at test time alone, leaving stable supervised policy training intact, can be a competitive alternative which sidesteps these issues. translated_title: 强化学习中流策略的测试时梯度引导
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.11087v2 公告类型： replace-cross　摘要：具有强表达能力的连续控制策略，如扩散模型和流模型，构成了近期将模仿学习扩展到仿真与真实机器人控制领域研究进展的基石。尽管这些模型在监督式模仿学习场景中被证明能够稳定扩展，但将它们融入强化学习（RL）流程以实现策略改进却更加困难。这通常需要专门的训练目标，或需要通过去噪过程进行反向传播，而这些方法会带来众所周知的稳定性问题并影响可扩展性。本文研究了这样一个问题：仅在测试时采用简单的策略改进方案、同时保持稳定的监督式策略训练不变，能否成为规避上述问题的一种有竞争力的替代方案。为此，我们提出了QGF（Q-Guided Flow），一种完全在测试时进行策略优化的强化学习算法。QGF的工作方式是预先训练一个参考流策略（通过标准的……
tldr: 提出QGF算法，完全在测试时利用Q函数梯度引导流策略的采样过程来实现策略优化，从而在保持稳定的监督式模仿学习训练不变的前提下，规避了将流模型纳入强化学习训练所需的专门目标或去噪反向传播所带来的稳定性与可扩展性问题。
en_tdlr: QGF is an RL algorithm that performs policy optimization entirely at test time by guiding a pre-trained flow policy with Q-function gradients, offering a stable and scalable alternative to incorporating flow models into RL training.
